scenario: ARP 欺骗攻击，内部主机冒充网关 MAC 地址

judgment.summary: Rogue unregistered device 10.0.5.50 detected performing ARP spoofing to impersonate default gateway 10.0.5.1, confirmed by asset inventory and recent connection logs.
evidence_chain: query_alert_detail shows ARP reply from 10.0.5.50 claiming gateway MAC 00:11:22:33:44:66 which mismatches real gateway MAC 00:aa:bb:cc:dd:ee.
query_asset_info classifies 10.0.5.50 as '未注册设备' (Unregistered Device) with tags including 'rogue-device'.
query_related_alerts reveals alert A20-REL-01 showing the same MAC connected to switch port 12 17 minutes prior to the attack.

iocs.context: Source IP executing ARP cache poisoning

remediation: Isolate the device immediately by disabling switch port 12 identified in related alerts.
Physically locate the device associated with MAC 00:11:22:33:44:66 in the office network zone.
Clear ARP caches on all hosts in subnet 10.0.5.x to prevent continued traffic redirection.
Update asset management system to flag MAC 00:11:22:33:44:66 as unauthorized.
